correctness.rationale: The two affine branches map the unit-area triangle onto itself with determinants ±2. I independently integrated the coordinate moments, reconstructed P(x-1)=0 and P(y-1/3)=((x-1)-(y-1/3))/2, verified the stated covariance matrices at 39 positive lags, and summed the infinite geometric kernel to Σ=(1/6)[[1,1/3],[1/3,1/9]]. The exact algebraic identity x-3y=(x-y)-(x-y)∘T holds on both branches, and H=x-y ranges over [0,2], with attained endpoint bound. P(x-1)=0 supplies bounded reverse martingale differences; full-branch contraction gives ergodicity, ergodic conditional variance 1/6 and Lindeberg, proving the coordinate martingale CLT. The other coordinate differs by a bounded coboundary and thus has the stated degenerate bivariate CLT.
